The start point (the grid junction/compressor from which the Hilla branch tees off) could NOT be independently located, so no start coordinate is asserted. If the sheet's 72 km length is taken at face value, the origin would sit ~72 pipe-km up the grid from Hilla (roughly the Musayyib/southern-Baghdad corridor), but that length is itself unverified (see spec concern), so treat the corridor as a loose north-to-Hilla bound only. Do not treat this as a routable geometry.
